studio.fx.sub: waveod modules in the pedal's flash
studio.fx.empty_text: Modules are waveod effects built separately (.elf files made with tools/wvfx.py). Once installed, they show up on the pedal and in the grid, in each category, after the original effects.
studio.fx.where: On the pedal and in the grid: {menu} › after the original effects.
studio.fx.hint: Writes to the pedal's flash; the sound drops out for a moment while it writes. A module with the same id replaces the installed one.
studio.fx.hint_errors: The files with errors are left out.
studio.fx.remove_text: Takes {name} off the pedal. Presets that use this effect keep the block (it shows as MISSING and the sound passes straight through) until it is installed again.
studio.nam.sub: the {total} Clone slots · on the pedal: CLONE › NAM
studio.nam.hint_empty: Nothing stored here: a .nam capture with the A2-Lite network runs on waveod's NAM engine; any .nam (A1, A2, LSTM, of any size) can be converted for the original Clone.
studio.nam.hint_original: A capture of the original Clone (from the original editor or converted by the Studio): it runs in the Clone block. Writing another capture here replaces it, and the pedal has no way to undo that.
studio.nam.hint_broken: The stored weights do not match the CRC: the slot does not play. Write the capture again.
studio.nam.hint_nam: Runs on waveod's NAM engine. Captures trained at 48 kHz run at 48 kHz with resampling, or at 44.1 kHz if written that way (lighter, a little brighter).
studio.nam.name_label: Name on the pedal (up to 16 letters)
studio.nam.convert_hint: Converted here on the PC to the original Clone's model (filter, saturation, filter), as the original editor does, but from any network: {arch}. An approximation, much lighter than the NAM engine. Takes from 10 s to a minute and a half. Reference signal: {di}.
studio.nam.di_editor: the original editor's (installed on this PC)
studio.nam.native_hint: Lighter; the sound gets a little brighter.
studio.nam.resampled_hint: Resampled: +1.4 ms and a little more DSP.
studio.nam.replaces_before: This replaces what slot {n} holds now:
studio.nam.replaces_after: ({kind}). It cannot be undone from the pedal; keep a copy first if it is a capture of yours.
studio.nam.no_lite: {file} ({arch}) has no A2-Lite network, and the Clone converter is not built
studio.irs.sub: the 20 user IRs · on the pedal: USER IR block (and waveod's Cab / IR)
studio.irs.rename_hint: Enter saves · Esc cancels · up to 16 letters
studio.irs.hint_used: 1024 samples at 44.1 kHz (23.2 ms), read from the pedal's flash: this is what the block plays.
studio.irs.hint_empty: Nothing stored here. A .wav written to this slot becomes a 1024-sample IR at 44.1 kHz (23.2 ms): the pedal keeps the start of the response, which is enough for a cabinet.
studio.irs.compare_aria: The new IR over the current one
studio.irs.clipped_one: {n} sample goes over full scale and will be clipped.
studio.irs.clipped_other: {n} samples go over full scale and will be clipped.
studio.irs.name_label: Name on the pedal (up to 16 letters)
studio.irs.replaces_after: Presets that use this slot will play the new one.
studio.mic.neutral_title: Position, distance and angle at 0: the IR's sound as captured
studio.mic.front_hint: drag: from the center to the edge of the cone
studio.mic.side_hint: drag the mic: distance and height · the back handle: the angle
studio.mic.change_hint: compared with the IR as captured
studio.drums.sub: My rhythms · on the pedal: DRUMS › MY RHYTHMS style
studio.drums.full_title: All 20 places are in use: empty one or replace one
studio.drums.import_title: Converts a .mid file and writes it to M{n}
studio.drums.vacant_text: Import a drum MIDI file. General MIDI drum notes become the pedal's 13 sounds; there are no toms, so those notes are left out (the Studio shows which). A looped rhythm starts over at the end of a whole bar; “once” stops at the end, good for a whole song.
studio.drums.name_label: Name on the pedal (up to 16 letters)
studio.drums.roll_hint: The file's tempo becomes the drums' tempo when the rhythm is picked, unless the drums follow the effects' tempo. Strong lines every 4 beats.
studio.drums.empty_text: Deletes the rhythm “{name}” from the pedal. To get it back, the MIDI file has to be imported again.
studio.drums.dropped: No sound on the pedal, left out: {list}.
studio.drums.cut: Too long: only the first {bars} bars fit ({cut} left out).
studio.drums.all_channels: The file does not use drum channel 10: every note was read as drums.
studio.drums.replaces: This replaces “{name}”, which is in M{n}.
